title: [📢 Release] Meet Lucy! : Your New Digital Muse✨
content:
Greetings, CONNECT Creators! 🥳

The wait is over! Our charming new avatar,   
**Lucy** , has officially arrived on CONNECT.   
  
![512a4630be2648e4a3117bd13352ccd2](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/a5c83c3dd6614c91a4262fa78e1fbe47/images/512a4630be2648e4a3117bd13352ccd2Lucy%20avt_community%20thumbanil.png)  
  
To support both your social adventures and your design workflows, we’ve released two different versions of Lucy, **both available for FREE.**

Whether you're looking to play in VRChat or design your next masterpiece in CLO/Marvelous Designer, here is everything you need to know.

* * *

## **[Gamewear] Jump Straight into VRChat!**

**👉**[**[Download Lucy : Unity Package for VRChat]**](https://connect.clo-set.com/gamewear/vrchat?vrchatCharacter=CHA01)  


  * **Specs :** Unity Package (FREE)

  * **For the Players :** This version is fully optimized for the ultimate VRChat experience. We didn't just export the model; we’ve completed the full **PhysBones** setup for you!

  * **Lifelike Detail :** Feel the vibrant, natural movement with Physics Bones applied to her hair and various parts. Everything sways perfectly as you move.

  * **Easy Setup :** Provided as a ready-to-use Unity Package, making it quick and easy even for beginners to upload and play.




  


## **[Store] The Ultimate Muse for Designers**

**👉**[**[Download Lucy : AVT for Designers]**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/2604DDbd4f849cd95b43ce9f7fb78c33971c98)  


  * **Specs :** Dedicated .avt version for CLO / Marvelous Designer

  * **For the Creators :** Ever wanted to see your designs on Lucy? Now you can. Skip the hassle of Maya or Blender—use **EveryWear** to design Lucy-specific outfits directly in CLO and MD.

  * **Seamless Compatibility :** Distributed as a dedicated .avt file, making the garment creation and fitting process smoother than ever.

  * **Maximize Efficiency :** Design outfits that perfectly fit Lucy’s unique silhouette and upload your creations to CONNECT right away!




* * *

### **📦 What’s Inside the Lucy Full Package?**

Lucy comes with a variety of parts to make customization fun and versatile:  
  
![3aa13a6b692748eabf46f2b297b40f37](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/a5c83c3dd6614c91a4262fa78e1fbe47/images/3aa13a6b692748eabf46f2b297b40f37lucy.png)

  * **1 Base Body :** The core Lucy avatar.

  * **4 Hair Styles :** Distinct looks to match any vibe.

  * **3 Sets of Ears & Tails :** Perfectly pull off any animal-inspired concept.

  * **4 Shoe Designs :** To complement various outfits.

  * **2 Sock Styles :** Essential accents for your final look.  
  
![dd16c85743c646c7a615d11aa7d02983](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/a5c83c3dd6614c91a4262fa78e1fbe47/images/dd16c85743c646c7a615d11aa7d02983lucy_parts%20copy.png)




* * *

**✨ Want to see more of Lucy?**

From high-fashion concepts to adorable snapshots, you can explore Lucy’s many looks on her official X (Twitter) account!

**👉**[**[Visit Lucy’s Official X Account]**](https://x.com/vrchat_lucy?s=20)

* * *

Choose the version that fits your needs and start your journey with Lucy on Gamewear and the Store today. We can’t wait to see the amazing worlds you explore and the stunning outfits you create!

[[Go to Gamewear]](https://connect.clo-set.com/gamewear/vrchat) | [[Go to Store]](https://connect.clo-set.com/store)

  


  


* * *

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there. Do I have to test my outfit on VRChat or will it be fine as long as the weight painting in Everywear is well-done?
Reply 1: Hi, animezointral! As long as the weight painting is done well in Everywear, it should be a great start. However, we recommend testing it directly in VRChat, as some mesh stretching or avatar movements might look different in-game. Testing in VRChat will help ensure everything looks perfect!
Reply 2: Thank you for the reply. I found the documentation and will follow it.

Comment 2: I have tried to upload Lucy poses for sale over the weekend, however, it kept showing failed to upload 3d Viewer. Any idea what can cause the problem?( The file was save as pos, and I selected women in gender&age then selected Lucy.)
Reply 1: The Lucy avatar pose conversion in web viewer is currently under development.I’ll let you know once it’s applied to Connect.Sorry for the inconvenience.
Reply 2: We've finished the work on the Lucy pose files today, so you should now be able to upload them without any issues.
Reply 3: Good to know that. Thank you!
Reply 4: One more question: When I save Lucy's pose, can I save Lucy's hair position and facial expression? Also, I tried to open the pose I created on Lucy and use a different hair style ( not the same one I used when creating the pose) , it will mess up the hair. I would have to delete the hair and import it back again. AS you can see in the pics...the first one was when I opened the pose and used a different hair style. So I deleted and reopened the hair which is the second pic. The 3rd picture is the hair style I used when creating this pose and it looks fine.So, will this be an issue when I try to sell Lucy's pose file? Do I need to indicate the pose is registered on which hair style? Or the buyers have to adjust the hair position themselves?
Reply 5: The issue does not occur when saving a Pose file, provided that no other accessories are worn.I've asked our software team to investigate and confirm the issue.

Comment 3: Can we create items for Lucy and sell on connect?
Reply 1: Yes, that’s fine. Feel free to create items for Lucy and publish them on connect for sale.
content_description: Discover and download Lucy, CONNECT’s versatile new avatar designed for immersive VRChat experiences and seamless fashion design in CLO/Marvelous Designer—completely free!
